title: Llama eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Llama body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='28' ry='18' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- Body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='69' rx='24' ry='12' fill='#e8d4a8'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='28' y='30' width='14' height='30' rx='6' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- Neck shading -->
  <rect x='30' y='32' width='4' height='26' rx='2' fill='#e8d4a8'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='28' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='32' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#e8d4a8'/>
  <!-- Nostril -->
  <circle cx='17' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#c4a878'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#7dc8e8'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='1.2' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='23' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='17' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#f5e6c8' transform='rotate(-15 24 17)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='16' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#f5e6c8' transform='rotate(10 34 16)'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='17' rx='1.5' ry='4' fill='#e8c8a0' transform='rotate(-15 24 17)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='16' rx='1.5' ry='4' fill='#e8c8a0' transform='rotate(10 34 16)'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <rect x='42' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <rect x='54' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <rect x='64' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='32' y='89' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c4a878'/>
  <rect x='42' y='89' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c4a878'/>
  <rect x='54' y='89' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c4a878'/>
  <rect x='64' y='89' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c4a878'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='58' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#e8d4a8'/>
  <!-- Snack: a bright orange carrot -->
  <path d='M16 36 L8 44 L12 46 L10 52 L16 48 Z' fill='#ff8c2a'/>
  <!-- Carrot top greens -->
  <path d='M16 36 L14 30 L18 34 L20 28 L20 36' fill='#4ade4a' stroke='#4ade4a' stroke-width='1.5' fill-opacity='1'/>
  <!-- Carrot shine -->
  <line x1='13' y1='42' x2='15' y2='38' stroke='#ffb060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Little crumb crumbs -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ff8c2a'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='51' r='0.8' fill='#ff8c2a'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='46' r='0.7' fill='#ff8c2a'/>
</svg>
